name: soe-marketing-drafts
description: SOE visibility/marketing DRAFTS only — no send, no post, no Stripe. Owner lock 2026-07-28.

steps.name: lock-reminder
steps.message: SOE marketing: drafts only. No auto-email, auto-post, or charges. CTA wholesale + site.

steps.name: promotion-package-if-present
steps.command: cd ~/gullahgeecheebiz-site && ls promotion-packages 2>/dev/null | tail -5; test -f scripts/regenerate-sitemap.py && python3 scripts/regenerate-sitemap.py 2>&1 | tail -3 || true

steps.name: wholesale-pitch-drafts-if-books-repo
steps.command: if [ -d ~/ggb-books/tools/wholesale_bookstore ]; then cd ~/ggb-books/tools/wholesale_bookstore && python3 generate_pitches.py --priority 1 2>&1 | tail -5; else echo 'wholesale_bookstore path not on this machine — skip'; fi

steps.name: done
steps.message: SOE marketing drafts pass complete — human review before any send/post
